ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය
අංක 1902/37 - 2015 ෙපබරවාරි මස 17 වැනි අඟහරුවාද - 2015.02.17 No. 1902/37 – TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 17, 2015

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Land Ministry Reference No.: LD/05/2004/HW/03. My Ref. No. C/Ath/RDA/SP/04/08/28-1. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose.
Description of the land to be Acquired:

Lot No. 01-03 (Lots 03) allotments in total extent of about 0.0192 Hectare, of land in Priliminary Plan No. CO. 9507 and dated 20.01.2015 prepared by the Surveyor-Superintendent on behalf of Surveyor - General situated in the Villages of Bambalapitiya (No. 47 Division - Bambalapitiya, in Colombo Municipal Council) in the Gramaniladhari Divisions Bambalapitiya in the Minor Division of in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Thimbirigasyaya in Colombo District in the Western Province. 01. Lot No. 01
Name of Land: Asst. No. Not be found; Description: Garden; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Not be found; Extent: 0.0034 Hectare. 02. Lot No. 02
Name of Land: Asst. No. Not be found; Description: Merinedrive Road; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: —; Extent: 0.0096 Hectare.

Name of Land: Asst. No. Not be found; Description: Merinedrive Road; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Not be found; Extent: 0.0062 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally or by agent duly authorized in writing, before me at Land Division, Road Development Authority of Sethsiripaya, Baththaramulla of the 23rd April 2015 at 10.30 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 18th day of March 2015, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
S. OPANAYAKE, Land Acquiring Officer and Director (Land), Road Development Authority. Land Division, Road Development Autority, 03rd Floor, Sethsiripaya, Battaramulla. 18th February, 2015. 03 - 69
